title: QuanVI: Score-based Variational Inference via Quantum Maximally Mixed States
abstract: arXiv:2609.39164v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Score-based variational inference (VI) provides an alternative to Kullback--Leibler (KL)-based VI by minimizing the Fisher divergence between the variational distribution and the target. A prior score-VI approach formulates this optimization as an eigenvalue problem, with the variational distribution constructed from low-energy eigenstates. However, this eigenvalue-based formulation faces two high-dimensional obstacles: an intractably large parameter count due to exponential scaling and non-uniqueness of individual eigenvectors in degenerate or nearly degenerate low-energy subspaces. We propose QuanVI, a scalable quantum-inspired algorithm that combines a mixed-state density-operator formulation with a quantum tensor network (QTN) parameterization using the matrix product operator (MPO) structure. translated_title: QuanVI：基于量子最大混合态的分数变分推断
translated_abstract: 基于分数的变分推断（VI）通过最小化变分分布与目标分布之间的Fisher散度，为基于Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度的变分推断提供了一种替代方案。已有的分数变分推断方法将这一优化问题表述为特征值问题，利用低能量本征态来构建变分分布。然而，这种基于特征值的表述面临两个高维障碍：一是由于指数级扩展导致的难以处理的大参数量，二是在简并或近简并的低能量子空间中单个本征向量的非唯一性。我们提出QuanVI，一种可扩展的量子启发算法，它将混合态密度算子表述与采用矩阵乘积算子（MPO）结构的量子张量网络（QTN）参数化相结合。在简并的低能量子空间中，密度算子表述通过其最大混合态来表示该子空间，而不依赖于……
tldr: QuanVI提出了一种可扩展的量子启发算法，将混合态密度算子表述与基于矩阵乘积算子（MPO）结构的量子张量网络参数化相结合，通过用最大混合态表示简并低能子空间，克服了基于特征值的分数变分推断方法中参数量指数级增长和本征向量非唯一性两大障碍。
en_tdlr: QuanVI is a scalable quantum-inspired algorithm combining a mixed-state density-operator formulation with quantum tensor network (MPO) parameterization, overcoming the exponential parameter scaling and eigenvector non-uniqueness of eigenvalue-based score-based variational inference by representing degenerate low-energy subspaces via maximally mixed states.
